_doc: Radio phraseology (ICAO / Indian AIP style). Section -> message key -> unit role (ATIS DEL GND TWR APP, or * for any) -> template or list of variants. {slots} are filled by atc_phraseology.gd; opt_* slots may be empty. See docs/ATC.md.

pushback.*: {fac}, {callsign}, Cessna 172 at {where}, request start-up and pushback

ready.*: {fac}, {callsign}, holding point runway {rwy}, ready for departure

ready_lined.*: {fac}, {callsign}, lined up runway {rwy}, ready for takeoff

taxi_stand.*: {fac}, {callsign}, runway {rwy} vacated, request taxi to the apron

blind_pushback.*: {apt} traffic, {callsign}, Cessna 172 at {where}, starting up and pushing back

blind_taxi.*: {apt} traffic, {callsign}, Cessna 172 at {where}, taxiing to runway {rwy}

blind_ready.*: {apt} traffic, {callsign}, Cessna 172, lining up and departing runway {rwy}

blind_inbound.*: {apt} traffic, {callsign}, Cessna 172, {pos}, {alt} feet, inbound for landing runway {rwy}

blind_taxi_stand.*: {apt} traffic, {callsign}, runway {rwy} vacated, taxiing to the apron

clearance.*: Cleared VFR, {opt_route}runway {rwy}, not above {alt_limit} feet, squawk {squawk}, QNH {qnh}, {callsign}

taxi.*: Taxi to holding point runway {rwy}{opt_via}, QNH {qnh}, {callsign}

taxi_sq.*: Cleared VFR, squawk {squawk}, taxi to holding point runway {rwy}{opt_via}, QNH {qnh}, {callsign}

goaround.*: Left-hand circuit runway {rwy}, will report downwind, {callsign}

vacate_nofreq.*: Vacating runway, will taxi to the apron, {callsign}

atis.ATIS: {apt} information {info}. Runway {rwy} in use. Wind {wind}. Visibility {vis}. {opt_wx}{clouds}. Temperature {temp}. QNH {qnh}. Acknowledge information {info} on first contact.
atis.*: {callsign}, runway {rwy} in use, wind {wind}, visibility {vis}, {opt_wx}{clouds}, temperature {temp}, QNH {qnh}.

clearance.*: {callsign}, cleared VFR, {opt_route}departure runway {rwy}, climb not above {alt_limit} feet, squawk {squawk}, QNH {qnh}.

pushback.*: {callsign}, start-up and pushback approved, report ready to taxi.

taxi.*: {callsign}, taxi to holding point runway {rwy}{opt_via}, QNH {qnh}.

taxi_sq.*: {callsign}, cleared VFR, squawk {squawk}. Taxi to holding point runway {rwy}{opt_via}, QNH {qnh}.

ready_far.*: {callsign}, continue taxi to the holding point runway {rwy} and report ready.

inbound_join.*: {callsign}, runway {rwy} in use, QNH {qnh}, {join}, report final.

land_wait.*: {callsign}, continue approach, runway {rwy} is occupied, report short final.

goaround.*: {callsign}, roger, join left-hand circuit runway {rwy}, report downwind.

vacate_nofreq.*: {callsign}, vacate runway when able and taxi to the apron.

wrong_freq.*: {callsign}, you are on the wrong frequency, contact {fac2} {freq}.

takeoff_no_clr.*: Note for {callsign}: no takeoff clearance has been given. Call the tower, ready for departure, before you roll (menu key `).

land_no_clr.*: Note for {callsign}: no landing clearance has been given. Report final to the tower; a go-around is advised until you are cleared.

hold_crossed.*: Note for {callsign}: you are on runway {rwy} without a clearance. Please call the tower before entering a runway.

com_failed.*: COM1 is dead: nothing can be sent or heard. Squawk 7600 and follow the lost-communications procedure.

com_off.*: COM1 is off: there is no power. Switch on the battery master and the avionics master (Shift+M, Shift+V).

no_reply.*: No reply on COM1 {freq}. {fac2} is on {freq2}.

no_airport.*: No airport within range of this radio.

uncontrolled.*: {apt} has no air traffic service in the data: calls are blind transmissions and nobody will answer. Keep a good lookout.
